audit.whatIsWrong: The text repeatedly calls Flamespitter and The Equalizer 'channels' ('before your Danger Zone Flamespitter finishes its channel', 'before a second Flamespitter channel completes').
audit.why: Riot's own description of Flamespitter is 'torches opponents in front of him, dealing magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds' — no channel. The kit library marks channelled abilities with a 'channel' flag (Master Yi's Meditate has it); none of Rumble's four abilities carry it. Calling it a channel tells the player to stand still, which is exactly the wrong instruction against a champion who wants you rooted in place.
audit.corrected: Flamespitter is a 3-second cone that stays on while Rumble walks and auto-attacks; the trade window is the cone's duration, not a cast time.
sources: champ-data/_kits/rumble.json (Q description, absence of channel flag)

audit.whatIsWrong: Every cooldown reference is qualitative ('respect his W auto-mark', 'when Lightning Rush is down') with no real numbers, so the player cannot count the window.
audit.why: The kit file has the exact values: Lightning Rush 10/9/8/7/6s at 80 energy, Electrical Surge 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s at 40 energy, Thundering Shuriken 7/6.25/5.5/4.75/4s at 60/55/50/45/40 energy, Slicing Maelstrom flat 120s. Rumble's Flamespitter is 10/9/8/7/6s — identical to Lightning Rush rank for rank, which is the single most useful fact in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Lightning Rush and Flamespitter share a cooldown curve (10s at rank 1 down to 6s at rank 5), so every time he burns E you are guaranteed a Q up before he is mobile again. Electrical Surge is his slowest button at 13s rank 1 — that is the real mark-stacking gate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kennen's energy economy is never mentioned anywhere in either layer.
audit.why: Kennen is the only Energy champion in this slice. Thundering Shuriken (60) + Electrical Surge (40) + Lightning Rush (80) is 180 energy at rank 1 — a full three-mark stun rotation empties him, and an empty Kennen has no Lightning Rush to leave with. That is the concrete punish window the entry keeps gesturing at without naming.
audit.corrected: A full Q-W-E stun rotation costs 180 energy at rank 1; step in on the rotation, not on the health bar.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late-game paragraph attributes Kennen's stun uptime to 'Hextech items' and names 'Hextech Rocketbelt' as a first-item spike.
audit.why: That item claim is not verifiable from anything on disk and item names shift between patches, so it should not be asserted. The verifiable ultimate comparison is stronger anyway: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s at all three ranks while The Equalizer is 130/105/80 — at rank 1 his ultimate is back before yours.
audit.corrected: Compare the ultimates by cooldown rather than by item: 120s flat for him, 130s at rank 1 for you.

audit.why: 49.74% over 380 games matches the EVEN framing and the level chart (Kennen 4 stages, Skill 2, Rumble 1). No change needed.

edits.before: With full kit online Kennen can Lightning Rush in, auto to proc three marks, stun you, and kite back before your Danger Zone Flamespitter finishes its channel.
edits.after: Kennen spends 80 energy on Lightning Rush, autos three Mark of the Storm procs for the stun, and leaves — his 10s rank-1 E is the same cooldown as your Flamespitter.

edits.before: Kennen can proc three marks and stun you while you cannot yet generate enough Heat to threaten him — respect his W auto-mark before committing Flamespitter range.
edits.after: Kennen stuns on the third Mark of the Storm before your Heat can threaten him — Electrical Surge is a 13-second cooldown at rank 1, so step up in the window after he spends it.

edits.before: Save Equalizer for dragon or baron fights where his Zhonya's stall becomes irrelevant against a ground AoE he cannot walk out of
edits.after: Punish his energy bar — a full Q, W and E stun rotation costs 180 energy at rank 1, leaving him nothing to Lightning Rush out with

edits.before: Kennen's first-item Hextech Rocketbelt or Shadowflame gives him enough burst plus stun chain to one-rotation Rumble before a second Flamespitter channel completes.
edits.after: Kennen's first-item burst plus a three-mark stun chain kills you inside one rotation — his damage is frontloaded, yours needs Flamespitter's full 3-second cone to land.

edits.before: Two or more items on Kennen and he becomes a teamfight monster with near-permanent uptime on his stun through Hextech items and high AP — you need to Equalizer before he Slicing Maelstroms, not after. Your win condition at this stage is aim and timing: drop the rocket line across the engagement path so the entire enemy team is slowed and burning before Kennen can R into Zhonya's, because once he presses those two buttons your Equalizer damage is wasted on an hourglass. On the flip side your own two-item Liandry's plus Shadowflame or Cryptbloom Equalizer still wins teamfights even if you personally die immediately after — that is the matchup's honest late-game truth and it is enough to justify every boring farming minute you spent in this lane.
edits.after: Two or more items on Kennen and he becomes a teamfight monster with near-permanent uptime on his stun — and Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120 seconds at every rank, so it comes back faster than your rank-1 Equalizer at 130. Aim the rocket line across the ground he must cross rather than at his body, and drop it early so the enemy team is slowed and burning before he can dive in and Zhonya's, because once he presses those two buttons your damage window is spent on an hourglass. On the flip side your own two-item Liandry's plus Shadowflame or Cryptbloom Equalizer still wins teamfights even if you personally die immediately after — that is the matchup's honest late-game truth and it is enough to justify every boring farming minute you spent in this lane.

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — His escape. All-in when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — 10s at rank 1 and 80 energy; all-in the moment he spends it. - Your Flamespitter: also 10s at rank 1, so the windows line up. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

notes: Systemic template defect in champ-data/rumble.full.js (not unique to Kennen): dosFull/dontsFull entries pair a matchup-specific title with a generic description that does not match it — e.g. dontsFull[1] is titled "Get triple-stunned" but described as "Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown", and dontsFull[2] "Fight into his R" carries the Overheat description. Those description strings are byte-identical across dozens of Rumble matchups, so apply-proposals.js would reject any edit to them as ambiguous ("before" appears >1x). They need a generator-side fix, not a proposal. Separately: the full layer cannot be corrected on diff / diffRating / carryRating / phases[].side at all, because those values are shorter than the 12-character minimum the full-layer string matcher requires.
